observations.why: Adopting a new analytics tool appeals to novelty and self-direction — choosing a new path over the existing one.
Quantified performance gain appeals to mastery and capability (competence) and to achievement over the current setup (self-enhancement).
Deferring migration to a scheduled future quarter appeals to stability and orderly planning rather than immediate disruption.
The memo's summary line restates the performance gain as an improvement, appealing to capability and quality of craft.
